result:
Admins can now create teams from a new Teams page at `/app/teams`. I haven't run tests, lint, type-checking or the app, as you asked, so none of it has been exercised.

- **API:** `src/features/teams/api/create-team.ts` adds `POST /teams` with `name` and `description`, both required and validated with Zod. Saving a team refreshes the teams list.
- **Mock API:** `src/testing/mocks/handlers/teams.ts` has a new `POST /teams` handler. It requires an authenticated admin, creates the team and persists it. A non-admin gets the same 500 "Unauthorized" error as the discussions handlers.
- **Create Team button:** `src/features/teams/components/create-team.tsx` is shown to admins only. It opens a form drawer with the two fields and a "Team Created" success notification after saving.
- **List:** `src/features/teams/components/teams-list.tsx` is a table of name, description and creation date, using the same date format as the users list.
- **Page and route:** `src/app/routes/app/teams.tsx` shows "Only admin can view this." to non-admins. I registered it in `src/config/paths.ts` and `src/app/router.tsx`.
- **Navigation:** `src/components/layouts/dashboard-layout.tsx` gets a "Teams" link, visible to admins only.

The existing `GET /teams` mock handler has no auth check, so any signed-in user could fetch the list even though the page itself is admin-only. I left it alone since you didn't ask for it to change.
